title: Adopt reusable generic mutation and query conformance
objective: Implement one business-neutral reusable mutation/query conformance boundary and prove it through contrasting real Customer Enrichment mutation and paginated Customer Privacy query owners without changing runtime algorithms or product semantics.
deliverables: add one reusable business-neutral mutation conformance suite
add one reusable business-neutral permission-aware query conformance suite
adopt both suites through contrasting Customer Enrichment and Customer Privacy real-process representatives
prove activation, live authorization, tenant, malformed input or cursor, replay, safe error and side-effect guarantees
add one permanent cross-owner authoritative conformance workflow and deterministic adoption guard
regenerate docs/ACTIVE_PACKET.md without changing repository inventory
acceptance: the same generic mutation/query suite source is reused by representative owners from two domains
mutation conformance proves activation, malformed input, tenant mismatch, live authorization denial, exact replay and atomic evidence
query conformance proves activation, tenant mismatch, live authorization denial, concealment, malformed cursor, bounded keyset pagination and zero writes
owner-specific domain semantics remain outside the generic suite
public coordinates, route classifications, runtime behavior, workspace package count, dependencies and Cargo.lock remain unchanged
non_goals: change generic runtime algorithms or add business-ID switches
change owner-specific product semantics or public inventory
add Customer Privacy workers or begin repository step 8
add crates, dependencies, manifests, migrations or persistence schema
refactor unrelated owner tests or workflows
